_comment: PER-MODEL METRICS SECTION CONFIGURATION FOR MAILSPHINX. MODELS LISTED UNDER 'exclude' FOR A GIVEN SECTION WILL NOT APPEAR IN THAT SECTION'S TABLE. USE [category, flavor] PAIRS MATCHING THE Model Category AND Model Flavor COLUMNS IN THE SPHINX DATAFRAME (E.G. HESPERIA REleASE splits to category='HESPERIA REleASE', flavor='ACE 30-min'). MODELS NOT LISTED ARE SHOWN BY DEFAULT.
